# coverage depth

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coverageDepth`](gmeow-coverageDepth.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coverageDepth>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)

The depth of coverage the source provides about the subject of a citation — significant coverage, passing mention, or routine filing. Non-functional: competing depth assessments coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
